It is separated from the wall, not suitable for an eccentric base, and there is little space between the toilet and the floor.

The available space to tighten the bolts does not allow for a flush installation against the wall. This is because the lower curve is poorly designed and very narrow (compared to another model from a competitor), which means you have to keep the back of the pond about 5 cm away from the wall. This is impractical—everything you place there falls over—and unappealing, as it looks like an island. Due to the limited space, you can't tighten it properly, so it will end up loose. We wasted a lot of time on the project, trying different types of tools (and money on the work) until we decided to replace it because what is very difficult to secure will be impossible to remove if the bolts rust later.

I bought 2 Fusion Corona toilets online. They arrived in poor condition with defects. I went through the entire process for review and warranty. They didn't resolve the issue; I've been waiting for 15 days, and yesterday they told me the case was closed. I'm still stuck with toilets that have defects in the ceramic, and the lids do not close smoothly.

Recently, I bought a Sevilla toilet from Corona. When it was installed, it emitted a bad sewer smell during use. I had the installer check it, and he confirmed it was properly sealed. Upon inspection, he noticed that there were two holes inside the toilet that were allowing the odors to escape. I contacted Corona, and the technician informed me that these were manufacturing holes and suggested I cover them with tape to stop the smell, which indeed worked. However, I was disappointed that for a toilet at this price, they didn't include two factory plugs to prevent this issue.

The product arrived with an imperfection on the lid. It doesn't affect its functionality, but it doesn't look good aesthetically. It's something that is not noticeable at first glance, which is why I didn't detect it on the day of delivery. My recommendation is to check everything very carefully when the order arrives. I also do not recommend the installation service through Home Center; it takes a long time after the product arrives. I had to cancel it and request a refund, then hire the service through another provider. If you need it urgently, as I did, this is not a viable option.

Review: When the tank is emptied, it continues to leak water through a valve at the bottom. Since there is no drainage to the bowl, over time it accumulates, and I have to remove it in buckets every eight days, or else it will start to rot.

Review: For such an expensive toilet, the quality of the flushing components should be better. The tank cracks and feels like it’s going to burst from the pressure, which could be deadly for my family. It’s acceptable for dynamic parts to need replacement after a few years, but it’s not right that a plastic tank, which takes ages to decompose in nature, gets damaged in just a few years in a bathroom.
